name: Robe of Words
body:
School abjuration; Level adept 4, bard 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration 1 min./Level, see text

DESCRIPTION

You complete the spell and your attire is covered in shifting runes and sigils. For the duration anytime you are targeted by, or affected by a spell with the language-dependent descriptor or any spell with the words, sigil, rune, symbol, word, or glyph in the name are defended against. Any such spell of 3rd level or lower is automatically blocked. A qualifying spell of 4th to 6th level is automatically subject to a caster level check to counterspell it as per the spell dispel magic, You can stop a number of spell levels equal to your caster level plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Any spells you fail to affect do not count against the levels used. If you have insufficient levels available to stop an incoming spell, it is unaffected. When all the spell levels are used, this spell ends.

Robes of Words, Greater

School abjuration; Level adept 5, bard 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch .

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as robe of words, except it automatically defends against qualifying spells of 5th level or lower and can attempt to counterspell spells from 6th to 9th level.
